channel.title: Daily Rosary
channel.description:
The Daily Rosary Podcast offers ten peaceful, prerecorded Rosary prayers—one for each day’s traditional mystery. Pray at your own pace and stay rooted in daily devotion wherever you listen.

Sundays follow the Church’s liturgical seasons:

  • Advent & Christmas: Joyful Mysteries
  • Lent: Sorrowful Mysteries
  • Easter & Ordinary Time: Glorious Mysteries

For a guided experience that automatically selects the correct mystery each day, visit DailyRosary.cf.

You can also pray through the Daily Rosary App on Android: Download the app.

Whether you listen on your favorite podcast platform or pray through the app, this podcast offers a simple, steady way to stay close to Christ in daily prayer.
channel.author: Eric Kouassi
channel.summary: Your companion for daily Rosary prayers, providing the mystery of the day with ease and convenience.

episodes.title: Monday Rosary — The Joyful Mysteries
episodes.description:
Join us this Monday for a peaceful meditation on the Joyful Mysteries of the Rosary. These mysteries invite you to reflect on Christ’s arrival and the humble love God reveals through the early life of Jesus.

Press play, pray along, and let the Joyful Mysteries guide your heart into gratitude and quiet devotion.

If you prefer a guided experience that automatically selects the correct mystery for the day, visit DailyRosary.cf.

You can also pray through the Daily Rosary App on Android: Download the app.

May this prayer bring you calm, clarity, and closeness to Christ.
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: A simple, peaceful way to begin your week in prayer.
episodes.summary: A peaceful Monday Rosary reflecting on the Joyful Mysteries, helping you begin the week with gratitude, hope, and quiet devotion.

episodes.title: Tuesday Rosary — The Sorrowful Mysteries
episodes.description:
Join us this Tuesday for a heartfelt meditation on the Sorrowful Mysteries of the Rosary. These mysteries draw us into Christ’s Passion and the depth of His love, inviting you to reflect on His suffering, His sacrifice, and the mercy offered to the world.

As you pray along, let these moments guide your heart into compassion, repentance, and renewed trust in God’s love.

For a guided experience that automatically selects the correct mystery each day, visit DailyRosary.cf.

You can also pray through the Daily Rosary App on Android: Download the app.

May this prayer draw you closer to Christ and deepen your trust in His love.

episodes.subtitle: A quiet space to enter Christ’s suffering with honesty, trust, and love.
episodes.summary: A peaceful Tuesday Rosary reflecting on the Sorrowful Mysteries, helping you meditate on Christ’s Passion with clarity and devotion.

episodes.title: Wednesday Rosary — The Glorious Mysteries
episodes.description:
Join us this Wednesday as we pray the Glorious Mysteries of the Rosary, celebrating Christ’s triumph and the hope poured out upon the world. These mysteries invite you to rejoice in His victory over sin and death, the gift of the Holy Spirit, and the promise of eternal life shared with all who believe.

Pray along and let these moments fill your heart with hope, joy, and renewed trust in God’s promises.

For a guided experience that automatically selects the correct mystery each day, visit DailyRosary.cf.

You can also pray through the Daily Rosary App on Android: Download the app.

May this prayer strengthen your faith and brighten your day with Christ’s light.

episodes.subtitle: A moment to rejoice in Christ’s victory and the hope He offers.
episodes.summary: A peaceful Wednesday Rosary reflecting on the Glorious Mysteries, inviting you into Christ’s triumph with clarity and joy.

episodes.title: Thursday Rosary — The Luminous Mysteries
episodes.description:
Join us this Thursday as we meditate on the Luminous Mysteries of the Rosary, contemplating the public ministry of Christ and the light He brings into the world. These mysteries reveal His teaching, His miracles, and the radiant love that calls every heart closer to God.

For a guided experience that selects the correct mystery each day, visit DailyRosary.cf.

You can also pray through the Daily Rosary App on Android: Download the app.

May this prayer strengthen your faith and fill your day with Christ’s light.

episodes.title: Friday Rosary — The Sorrowful Mysteries
episodes.description:
Join us this Friday as we return to the Sorrowful Mysteries of the Rosary, entering more deeply into Christ’s Passion and the love that led Him to the Cross. These mysteries invite us to reflect on His suffering, His sacrifice, and the mercy He offers to the world through His self‑giving love.

You can also pray through the Daily Rosary App on Android: Download the app.

May this prayer deepen your compassion, strengthen your faith, and draw you closer to Christ.

episodes.title: Saturday Rosary — The Joyful Mysteries
episodes.description:
Join us this Saturday as we pray the Joyful Mysteries of the Rosary, celebrating the beginnings of salvation and the humble love of God revealed through Mary.

These mysteries invite us to rejoice in the Incarnation, the Visitation, the Nativity, the Presentation, and the Finding of Jesus in the Temple.

episodes.title: Sunday Rosary — The Glorious Mysteries

These mysteries invite us to reflect on the Resurrection, the Ascension, the Descent of the Holy Spirit, the Communion of Saints, and the Coronation of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

You can also pray through the Daily Rosary App on Android: Download the app.

These mysteries invite us to rejoice in God made flesh, the humility of the Holy Family, and the joy that fills the world through the coming of our Savior.

episodes.title: Sunday Rosary — The Sorrowful Mysteries (Lent)
episodes.description:
During the penitential season of Lent, the Church prays the Sorrowful Mysteries on Sundays, entering deeply into Christ’s Passion and the mercy poured out for our salvation.

The Agony in the Garden
The Scourging at the Pillar
The Crowning with Thorns
The Carrying of the Cross
The Crucifixion

Let these mysteries draw you into repentance, compassion, and renewed trust in God’s love.

For a guided experience that selects the correct mystery each day, visit DailyRosary.cf.

You can also pray through the Daily Rosary App on Android: Download the app.
